__dyl_g: Wendel "Bones" Dyl, a farmhand from Northwick, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F19. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Wendel "Bones" Dyl came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Wendel "Bones" Dyl wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Wendel "Bones" Dyl's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F19 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Wendel "Bones" Dyl watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
_champions: "You're late," said the corporal when Severin Champions arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Severin Champions shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Severin Champions took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Severin Champions helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
allu91825: Felix "Lucky" Allu told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. Orders came through: Felix "Lucky" Allu is a field cook now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pressed cornflower.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Felix "Lucky" Allu wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home reached Felix "Lucky" Allu before dusk. Felix "Lucky" Allu read it twice and slept a little easier.

On a quiet night Felix "Lucky" Allu (Concord) and Albin "Tin" Ringwraith (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home reached Felix "Lucky" Allu before dusk. Felix "Lucky" Allu read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F22 with the rations. Felix "Lucky" Allu ate while listening to the revised orders.
bascinetpuppy: The sergeant gave Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
elliott_goyhenetche: Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche unpacked a lock of hair in a matchbox at R-C9. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche became a rifleman today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home found Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche before the night shift. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche folded it small and kept it close.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. A letter from home found Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche before the night shift. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche is number 705 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
felixwallner: Ivo Felixwallner stepped off the supply cart at P-F14 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Ivo Felixwallner wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ivo Felixwallner watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
florida_man216: Karel Man came up with a draft of replacements on Day 5. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Karel Man taught Benedikt Rezasiibiil to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home reached Karel Man before dusk. Karel Man read it twice and slept a little easier.
Karel Man was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
The fog lifted at noon and Karel Man saw the Drowned Farm clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.
Felix Crobus fell asleep on watch. Karel Man took over without waking Felix, and told the sergeant nothing.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Man watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Karel Man was hit through the stomach at R-S11. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz). Karel Man was hit at R-S11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz).

Casimir Man put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Karel Man helped clear the shelf without saying why. Casimir Man got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 431. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Casimir Man helped stack spare sandbags at R-S11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
gdaydane: Hugo Gdaydane stepped off the supply cart at V-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_: Quentin Nieuwenhuis found a place in S-C7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Quentin Nieuwenhuis shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Quentin Nieuwenhuis waited for that to change. When it did, Ulrich Emmettofthek was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin Nieuwenhuis answered to number 726. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Quentin Nieuwenhuis could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
ihatethis1988: Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis was a clockmaker in Tannenfeld until the posters went up. He came to T-F21 with a photograph gone soft at the edges, and within a day the whole squad knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.

Dawn watch. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bastian Teamkaylin, badly wounded. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
justmusl: They issued Benedikt Justmusl a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a photograph gone soft at the edges in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem fell asleep on watch. Benedikt Justmusl took over without waking Button, and told the sergeant nothing. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Benedikt Justmusl shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
martin.el12: On Day 9 Dorian "Ash" Martin took a post at Q-F11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He knows every star by name, and the men liked him for it.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Ash" Martin heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Ash" Martin lent Emil Sup a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F11 with the rations. Dorian "Ash" Martin ate while listening to the revised orders.
ryann.lg: Roland Ryann found a place in T-F15 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Ryann watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Otto Fin (Hegemony) and Roland Ryann (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Hill 304 for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Roland Ryann kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
sammmmyv523: Emil Sammmmyv came up on Day 10 carrying news from Northwick. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Emil Sammmmyv was hit in the forearm at P-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Teodor Serdr of the Concord (@serdr.tg). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Emil Sammmmyv shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
zxburg4827: In Northwick, Leopold Zxburg was a blacksmith. In T-F23, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a blacksmith again.

The men at T-F23 heard Leopold Zxburg call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Oskar "Bones" Theophane of the Concord (@theophane_br). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Leopold Zxburg fell at T-F23 and never moved again. Shot by Oskar "Bones" Theophane of the Concord (@theophane_br).

The papers connected Henrik Zxburg to Leopold Zxburg. The men took longer to learn Henrik Zxburg's own habits, but they made the effort. Victory at Grey Mill. Henrik Zxburg let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
